#@ requires 1 == 1
    #@ ensures 1 == 1
    #@ assigns self._abstract_ops
    def _handle_unaryop_expr(
        self,
        expr: Dict[str, Any],
        local_refs: Set[str],
        invariant_ctx: bool,
        subst: Optional[Dict[str, str]],
    ) -> str:
        e = self._expr_to_whyml(expr["expr"], local_refs, invariant_ctx, subst)
        op = self._op(expr["op"])
        if op == "+":
            return e
        if op == "not":
            e = self._to_bool(e, expr["expr"])
        return f"({op} {e})"
